An activity-based project only. A new activity is what
brings its board into existence. The state is not edited
here: it is set by its own request.
What the change takes is disclosed before it is
submitted, and where tasks are still open the answer
travels with the request: close them with the activity, set
them aside, or leave them open. Where nothing is open
